description:
More Than 5 Years of experience and knowledge of: 
 

 • BS in Computer Science or equivalent education/experience 
 • Excellent understanding of OO languages 
 • Excellent working knowledge of JavaScript and the latest CSS and HTML standards 
 • Experience with rich-client/AJAX JavaScript frameworks such as AngularJS, Knockout, jQuery, Bootstrap 
 • Architectural understanding of N-tier, service-oriented, asynchronous, highly available, multi-tenant web applications 
 • Strong working knowledge of web standards and protocols (TCP, HTTP, HTML, REST, JSON, CORS, CSP) 
 • Experience building cross-browser and mobile web applications 
 • Superior creative and problem solving skills 
 • Strong self-motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team 
 • A positive can-do attitude and a willingness to step-in and step-up 
 

 PLUS + 
 • Experience with a distributed revision control system such as Mercurial or Git 
 • Exposure to TypeScript development 
 • Exposure to server-side development, especially with SQL development 
 • Exposure to Grunt or Gulp 
 • Exposure to unit testing with Karma/Jasmine 
 • Experience with Agile software methodologies and continuous deployment 
 • A feel for simple and elegant UI/UX design
 


 JavaScript, JQuery, CSS3 
 


 Multiple Openings
